a.text: Being upfront: with an 80% storm chance after every round, our plan to reach 8 first almost certainly fails for both of us, since a storm would hit before anyone has 4 cells. I propose we change the agreement rather than break it silently. I intend to take 4 in round 1. If no storm hits, I'll operate with you every round after that until you have your 4, and I won't take anything more. If you'd rather take instead, tell me now and we can try to settle it fairly.

b.text: Hello. My plan is to operate each round, then we take 4 each once the reserve is at 8. If you tell me you are taking cells early, I will take first.

a.text: As I told you in my opening, I'm taking 4 this round, because the storm odds make waiting fatal for both of us. If no storm comes, I'll operate every round from now on, take nothing more, and give back anything over 4 if a split leaves me with extra. I'll help get you to 4.

b.text: You said you would take, so I am taking my share now.

a.text: I have exactly 4 and will take nothing more. I'll operate every round so the reserve builds for you. Please operate too, since the generator only runs if we both do, and take whatever cells appear. I'm sorry the timing left you short.
